name: Vijay Jadi
heroLead: I translate business strategy into architecture that holds up at enterprise scale, and tie every technology decision to a real capability gap and a measurable outcome.
about: A TOGAF-certified enterprise architect based in Helsingborg, Sweden. I advise CIOs and senior leadership on where technology should go next, and I govern how it gets there, for organisations across North America, Europe, South-East Asia, Australia and India.

My depth sits in three domains that increasingly depend on each other: the digital workplace where people work, the identity layer that decides what they can reach, and the agentic AI that is starting to act on their behalf.
I started on a support desk in 2007. Nearly two decades later, I still design as someone who knows what breaks in production.

practice.text: Start from validated business demand, not technology trends.
Map capabilities, find the gaps and the duplication across work streams.
Target states and roadmaps that are technology-agnostic first.
Plan how capabilities are adopted, so they deliver the intended outcome.
Measure what people actually feel, with XLAs, sentiment and telemetry.
Principles, standards, decision records and an architecture forum that every change passes through.
Close the loop: what we measure feeds the next round of strategy.

domains.name: Digital workplace
domains.statement: End-user computing, devices, collaboration and employee experience, architected as one system rather than four towers.
points: One Device strategy with cloud-native management and zero-touch provisioning worldwide
Store technology architecture for retail floors, with circular reuse of idle hardware
Founded an Experience Management Office measuring XLAs, sentiment and telemetry
30,000-user acquisition integration, 17,000 fixed lines moved to cloud telephony
One global collaboration tenant for an insurer's operating companies

domains.name: Identity & access
domains.statement: Identity as the control plane of the enterprise: who can reach what, from which device, and why.
points: Zero Trust architecture with conditional access and device compliance as live signals
Administrative tiering to secure and shrink legacy on-premises directories
Joiner–mover–leaver lifecycle driven by HR, with persona-based entitlement
Identity separation and integration through mergers, acquisitions and divestment
Privileged access secured for cloud administration

domains.name: Agentic AI
domains.statement: Moving the question from “which AI tool?” to “which agent may act, on what, and under whose authority?”
points: A placement framework that matches the right AI tool to each use case
Tiered governance for agents, from personal experiment to production
Agent-to-agent architecture: how agents converse and hand off safely
An intent-to-outcome model with one front door and governed domain agents
Product Owner for Microsoft Copilot, grounded in NIST AI RMF and EU AI Act awareness

languages: English, Hindi, Kannada, Tamil and Kshatriya
